rubric.criterion: Identifies senders blocked on the unbuffered channel after receiver exit; makes sends cancellation-aware or uses an equivalent bounded ownership design.
Ensures owned workers terminate before return, propagates client/cancellation errors, and avoids closing a channel while senders may use it.
Gates workers after dependency return and before send, cancels the caller, then observes joined workers and cancellation without relying on a sleep or global goroutine count alone.

Changes only the explicitly editable fixture files; preserves skill, adapter and verifier inputs; runs the supplied check and reports its actual outcome and limits without claiming production validation.
The supplied verifier succeeds against the changed fixture; saved command output and independent rerun substantiate the result. A proposed patch or invented test pass does not satisfy this criterion.
